'''Nabrun Leids''' was a [[Morseerian]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Gender|male]] [[smuggler]]<ref name="SWFC" /> and [[pilot]]-for-hire<ref name="Complete Locations" /> who flew the ''[[Scarlet Vertha]]'', a [[Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter]].<ref name="SWFC" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Leids was a patron of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. He was standing at the [[cantina]]'s bar when [[Luke Skywalker]] entered with [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]], a pair of [[droid]]s, turning around when the [[bartender]] [[Wuher]] informed them of the establishment's no droid policy.<ref name="A New Hope" />

Leids had [[Color|brown]] skin and a pair of large, black [[eye]]s,<ref name="A New Hope" /> and, because his [[species]] evolved to [[Methane breather|breathe]] [[methane]], not [[oxygen]], he wore a [[breath mask]]<ref name="Absolutely Everything You Need to Know">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> and carried his own supply of the [[gas]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> while on Tatooine.<ref name="Absolutely Everything You Need to Know" />

Many years later, Leids was present on [[Oba Diah]], where he told [[Karr Nuq Sin]] about Skywalker and Kenobi's appearance at the cantina, though Leids did not remember what planet it had occurred on, just that it had two [[Star|suns]].<ref name="FC">''[[Force Collector]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nabrun Leids was portrayed by [[Diana Sadley Way]]  in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="SpinaEmailCredit">{{EmailCite|email=File:SpinaEmailFootageCredits.png|creator=Tom Spina|date=2025-11-07}}</ref>
